🚨JUST IN: THE DOJ IS ON FIRE! 🔥SMARTMATIC INDICTED OVER CONSPIRING TO BRIBE FOREIGN OFFICIALS AND MONEY LAUNDERING‼️

Voting-technology provider Smartmatic was charged Thursday with conspiring to bribe foreign officials and money laundering over a decade-old effort to win business in the Philippines.

The Justice Department added the parent company of Smartmatic, SGO Corporation Ltd., as a defendant in a criminal case earlier filed in Miami federal court against three Smartmatic executives. While employers face punishment for the misconduct of employees, criminal indictments of companies are rare. Corporations generally try to settle with prosecutors to avoid a trial and resume doing business.

Smartmatic said Thursday that it had cooperated with the government’s investigation and blamed the move to file charges on “powerful interests.”
“Smartmatic will continue to stand by its people and principles,” it said. “We will not be intimidated by those pulling the strings of power.”

The company has been in court for the past several years after suing conservative news outlets and allies of Trump who said voting-machine companies rigged the 2020 election for Joe Biden. Many defendants such as Fox News continue to fight Smartmatic’s claims, while Newsmax agreed last year to pay $40 million to settle with the company, according to regulatory filings.

The new criminal claims against Smartmatic stem from its attempt to win business in the Philippines in 2016. Smartmatic executives allegedly directed $1 million in bribes to be paid to a top Philippines election official. Smartmatic won contracts valued at $199 million, according to court filings.

Smartmatic executives Roger Alejandro Piñate Martinez and Jorge Miguel Vasquez were charged with foreign bribery and money laundering violations in August 2024. A third executive, Elie Moreno, was charged with money laundering and conspiracy. Piñate and Moreno are Venezuelan citizens, according to prosecutors. Vasquez is a U.S. citizen. The men are fighting the charges.

“Katotohanan at Pananagutan”—this was the demand of Akbayan Partylist, Tindig Pilipinas, and Youth Against Kurakot (YAK!) as they held a White Ribboning and Noise Barrage at Kamias cor. EDSA on Friday morning, calling for the immediate filing of charges and imprisonment of those implicated in the trillion-peso flood control scandal. The groups distributed and pinned white ribbons on pedestrians and commuters to symbolize the people’s demand for truth, justice, and accountability.

Youth Against Kurakot Lead Convenor and Akbayan Youth Secretary General Khylla Meneses expressed frustration over the government’s slow response to the corruption issue, “The Filipino people work hard, but the corrupt steal harder. Kaya ang panawagan natin ay sana naman sipagan pa ng gobyerno ang pagiimbestiga, pag-file ng kaso, at pagpapakulong sa lahat ng mga kurakot,” Meneses said.

“Anong petsa na? Magta-tatlong buwan na ang lumipas pagkatapos ng SONA ni Marcos Jr. at ipinangako niya na papanagutin ang mga kurap. Ilang baha pa ba ang hihintayin? Ilang bagyo pa ba ang papadaanin? Babad na babad na kami dito sa baha oh,” she added.

Read more: https://t.co/cWMx7S1OZl

#AkbayanPartylist

NOW: Students from various UP Manila colleges walked out of their classes and blocked Pedro Gil St. cor. Taft Ave. to protest widespread corruption under the Marcos-Duterte regime.

Following successful walkout on Sept. 12, where over 600 students marched, today’s mobilization carries calls against budget cuts in UP Manila and the Philippine General Hospital, reflected in long-standing infrastructure delays across campus grounds.

Participants will later join other universities in a march to Mendiola, where the program for the National Day of Action Kontra Korapsyon will commence.

(17/10/2025)

Hey crypto fam! It's Tila here, your go-to Research Guru diving into today's market chaos. Total cap sits at ~$2.1T, down 3.65% in 24h amid lingering crash echoes. $BTC's testing $108K support, alts bleeding harder – but high volumes ($84B on BTC, $46B on ETH) scream shakeout, not surrender. Is this the dip before Q4 fireworks? Let's unpack with structure. 

1. X Buzz Snapshot: Community Pulse & Trader Vibes

X is buzzing with "HODL or fold?" energy – fear's high, but diamond hands are stacking. @TheBuzzerrrr nailed the majors: $BTC ~$108,800 (slight green intraday but -2% overall), $ETH ~$3,913 (-2.39%), $SOL ~$185 (-4.9%), $XRP $2.34 (-3%). @BytenovaAI echoes the pain: Altcoins hammered post-Oct 10 crash, but $BNB holds at $1,145 as a "survivor" – HODL calls for $BTC/$ETH, buy dips on $XAUT/$PAXG as hedges.

@KunzinTv's 360° scan shows BTC at $108,660 (-10.71% 7d), ETH $3,912 (-10.43%), with $SUI (-26.53%) and $AVAX (-25.93%) as biggest losers – but $TRX (-5.91%) shines resilient. Sentiment? 60% FUD on liquidations ($725M longs wiped), 40% "buy the fear" – @SAFi_Systems pushes $BNB portfolio for upside room. Oversold RSI? Rebound whispers if $BTC flips $110K. 

2. Key News Hammering the Market: Crash Aftermath & Macro Pressures

Today's bleed ties to last week's $1T wipeout – 9x bigger than Feb 2025's crash, sparked by Trump tariff scares on US-China trade. $BTC dipped to $108K in hours, alts down 70% peak – now, hedging rush into tokenized gold ($XAUT surges). Fed's Michael Barr warns on stablecoin risks at D.C. Fintech Week: "Tight regs to dodge systemic threats."

Bull flips: Florida eyes $BTC/ETFs for state pensions (billions inbound?), Newsmax okays $5M $BTC treasury + Trump Coin. VanEck's S-1 for Lido Staked $ETH ETF adds fuel. But FUD lingers: Regional banks teeter, VIX at 25 signals TradFi jitters – $BTC's hedge play vs. debasement. Volatility's king; watch US jobs data for swings. 

3. Hottest Tokens & Projects: Hype Machines in the Dip

Presales & narratives are stealing spotlight amid red – AI/DeFi rotation, meme resilience. From buzz: $MOBU (MoonBull AI bot) presale at $0.012 eyes 1000x; $HYPE (Hyperliquid) holds better (-16.55% 7d) with $1.4B buybacks. $RTX (Remittix PayFi) raised $27.5M, XRP rival. Low-caps like $BZIL/$CULEX meme/DeFi on Solana buzzing.

Leading the pack is $MOBU (MoonBull), the AI trading bot crushing presales at $0.012 stage – it's all about that 1000x Q4 rocket potential driven by the hot AI narrative sweeping X. Next up, $HYPE (Hyperliquid) is flexing with $1.4B in buybacks year-to-date, trading around $37 and gunning for its $50 ATH soon – a smart early rebound bet if $BTC stabilizes. Don't sleep on $RTX (Remittix), the PayFi contender that's already raised $27.5M and is positioning hard as an XRP challenger in the remittance game, with massive buzz building.

For L1 plays, $SUI is deeply oversold at ~$2.5 after a brutal -26% weekly dip – this screams accumulation opportunity ahead of the cycle top for patient holders. Solana ecosystem wildcards like $BZIL and $CULEX are lighting up as high-risk, high-reward meme/DeFi gems, with X shills going viral right now. Rounding out the hype, AI-integrated Layer-1 presales such as Nexchain and Tapzi are breathing new life into the narrative, drawing early-stage crowds with their innovative twists. DYOR – volatility's wild, but these are X's darlings. 

4. Ongoing Events: Farm Airdrops & IDOs Before They Drop

October's airdrop paradise – Solana/Eth L2 focus. Live now: ChainGPT's $250K $BUZZ via Talisman (ends TODAY! – farm on Pad). Rainbow $RNBW points for on-chain activity (TGE Q4, @rainbowdotme). Monad claim live – NFT/bot fixes (@monad).

Ongoing: TSPILL, POLYDOGE, Grass Season 2 (@getgrass_io – DePIN rewards). Upcoming: Meteora $MET TGE Oct 23 (Solana LP qualify), Pipe/Ellora Network drops. IDOs: Vu Protocol public sale 09:00 UTC TODAY on WhiteBridge; ZEROBASE $ZBT zk-IDO. Momentum $MMT on Sui Oct 25 (@buidlpad). Farm smart – real tasks win, no bots. 

5. Politics, FUD & Shills: Narratives Shaping the Chaos

Shill surge: Florida's $BTC pension push + Singapore's BLOOM stablecoin program signal adoption wave. Philippines Blockchain Budget Bill eyes transparency (but privacy FUD). Trump Coin treasury hype ties to $BTC reserves – @amtvmedia shills "Fed replacement via gold-to-token rotation." CZ (@cz_binance) pumps $BNB as red-market anchor (-2%).

FUD storm: Trade war "crowd panic" as buy signal (@cointelegraph), Paxos $300T stablecoin "errors," regional banks on brink. UK FCA tokenized funds roadmap boosts but warns ops barriers. Politics? Trump-Putin Ukraine talks could de-escalate risk-off (@CDemanincor).

 Wall of worry = entry point. 

Final Take: Red day tests nerves, but patterns echo pre-rally setups – $BTC to $130K EOM if $107K holds? Stack, farm, ignore noise. Top pick? $HYPE for resilience. 

What's yours? Drop below! DYOR/NFA. Follow @hngth_nov for more.
